intro.en: Where floods are documented, the water will come back. These are the things to keep doing, in every season, so that the next flood finds people ready.
intro.sw: Pale mafuriko yalipoandikwa, maji yatarudi. Haya ni mambo ya kuendelea kufanya, kila msimu, ili mafuriko yajayo yawakute watu wako tayari.

en: Know how high past floods reached and keep beds, stores and power sockets above that mark.
Keep documents, medicines and some cash in a sealed bag that can be picked up quickly.
Treat or boil drinking water after any flood, and keep a covered store of clean water.
sw: Fahamuni kiwango cha juu ambacho mafuriko ya zamani yalifikia na wekeni vitanda, akiba na soketi za umeme juu ya alama hiyo.
Hifadhini nyaraka, dawa na fedha kidogo kwenye mfuko usiopitisha maji unaoweza kuchukuliwa haraka.
Tibuni au chemsheni maji ya kunywa baada ya mafuriko yoyote, na wekeni akiba ya maji safi iliyofunikwa.

en: Keep the river reserve free of crops and structures, and store the harvest and stock on raised platforms.
sw: Acheni hifadhi ya mto bila mazao wala majengo, na hifadhini mavuno na bidhaa kwenye sakafu zilizoinuliwa.

who.sw: Kamati za kijiji, mtaa na kata

en: Mark the flood-prone plots and the safe places, and agree with residents how the word is passed when the river rises.
Keep the list of households who need help to move up to date, and practise the route once a year.
sw: Wekeni alama viwanja vinavyofurika na mahali salama, na kubalianeni na wakazi jinsi taarifa inavyopitishwa mto unapopanda.
Sasisheni orodha ya kaya zinazohitaji msaada kuhama, na fanyeni mazoezi ya njia mara moja kwa mwaka.

en: Keep the drains, culverts and river crossings clear, and the flood-prone areas out of new building permits.
Keep the river gauges read, and TMA's and the basin board's advice reaching the wards.
sw: Wekeni mitaro, makalavati na vivuko vya mito wazi, na maeneo yanayofurika nje ya vibali vipya vya ujenzi.
Hakikisheni vipimo vya mito vinasomwa, na ushauri wa TMA na bodi ya bonde unazifikia kata.

en: Build new rooms and latrines on higher ground or raised plinths, and keep a safe place for livestock.
Agree with neighbours who checks on older persons, people with disabilities and children living near the water.
sw: Jengeni vyumba vipya na vyoo kwenye ardhi ya juu au misingi iliyoinuliwa, na wekeni mahali salama kwa mifugo.
Kubalianeni na majirani nani anawafuatilia wazee, watu wenye ulemavu na watoto wanaoishi karibu na maji.

en: Plan and keep protective works (embankments, drains, raised roads) and the gradual move of the most exposed households, with the land and water sectors.
sw: Pangeni na tunzeni kazi za kinga (matuta, mitaro, barabara zilizoinuliwa) na uhamishaji wa taratibu wa kaya zilizo hatarini zaidi, pamoja na sekta za ardhi na maji.
